points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 戈培尔出生于德国莱茵兰地区的雷特市，是家中唯一一个活到成年的孩子。他因小儿麻痹症导致腿部残疾，这影响了他的社交生活和自我认知。他在海德堡大学学习文学和哲学，获得了博士学位。在此期间，他接触了民族主义思想，并开始对政治产生浓厚兴趣。他的早期作品显示出强烈的反犹主义倾向和对德国民族主义的热情，这些思想后来成为纳粹意识形态的重要组成部分。
points.descriptionEn: Goebbels was born in Rheydt, Rhineland, Germany, as the only child to survive into adulthood. His clubfoot, a result of polio, affected his social life and self-perception. He studied literature and philosophy at Heidelberg University, earning a doctorate. During this period, he was exposed to nationalist ideas and developed a strong interest in politics. His early writings showed pronounced anti-Semitic views and enthusiasm for German nationalism, which later became integral components of Nazi ideology.

points.title: 纳粹崛起
points.description: 1924年，戈培尔加入纳粹党，并在慕尼黑开始了他的政治生涯。他被希特勒的演讲才能和民族主义思想所吸引。1925年，希特勒出狱后，戈培尔成为其忠实追随者。1926年，他被任命为纳粹党在柏林地区的领导人，开始在那里建立党组织。1927年，他创办了《进攻报》，作为纳粹党的宣传工具。在此期间，他发展出了自己独特的宣传风格，强调情绪煽动和简单化的信息传播，这些技巧后来成为纳粹宣传的核心。
points.descriptionEn: In 1924, Goebbels joined the Nazi Party and began his political career in Munich. He was captivated by Hitler's oratory skills and nationalist ideas. After Hitler's release from prison in 1925, Goebbels became a devoted follower. In 1926, he was appointed leader of the Nazi Party in Berlin, where he began building the party organization. In 1927, he founded the newspaper 'Der Angriff' as a propaganda tool for the Nazis. During this period, he developed his distinctive propaganda style, emphasizing emotional agitation and simplified messaging, which later became central to Nazi propaganda techniques.

points.title: 宣传大师
points.description: 1928年，戈培尔被选为国会议员，开始在柏林的政治舞台上崭露头角。他利用议会讲坛进行宣传，同时继续扩大《进攻报》的影响力。1930年，他被任命为纳粹党宣传部门负责人，全面负责党的宣传工作。在此期间，他发展出了'大谎言'理论，认为通过不断重复谎言，即使是最荒谬的谎言最终也会被接受为真理。他组织了大规模的集会和游行，利用新兴的广播和电影技术进行宣传。1932年，他策划了针对魏玛共和国政府的激烈宣传攻势，为纳粹党赢得1933年选举奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1928, Goebbels was elected to the Reichstag, beginning to make his mark on Berlin's political stage. He used parliamentary platforms for propaganda while continuing to expand the influence of 'Der Angriff.' In 1930, he was appointed head of the Nazi Party's propaganda department, taking full charge of the party's propaganda efforts. During this period, he developed his 'big lie' theory, which held that through constant repetition, even the most absurd lie would eventually be accepted as truth. He organized mass rallies and demonstrations, utilizing emerging radio and film technologies for propaganda. In 1932, he orchestrated an intense propaganda campaign against the Weimar Republic government, laying the groundwork for the Nazi Party's victory in the 1933 elections.

points.title: 帝国宣传部长
points.description: 1933年希特勒上台后，戈培尔被任命为国民教育与宣传部部长，成为纳粹政权最重要的宣传人物。他迅速控制了德国所有的媒体机构，包括报纸、广播、电影和艺术。他组织了大规模的焚书活动，焚烧被认为是'非德意志'的书籍。1936年柏林奥运会期间，他利用奥运会进行纳粹宣传，展示德国的'新秩序'。二战期间，他负责战争宣传，试图掩盖德国的军事失败，同时煽动民众继续战斗。1944年，他被任命为总体战专员，负责动员德国经济和人力资源支持战争。随着战争局势恶化，他的宣传变得更加极端和绝望。
points.descriptionEn: After Hitler came to power in 1933, Goebbels was appointed Reich Minister of Public Enlightenment and Propaganda, becoming the Nazi regime's most important propaganda figure. He quickly took control of all German media outlets, including newspapers, radio, film, and the arts. He organized large-scale book burnings of works considered 'un-German.' During the 1936 Berlin Olympics, he used the event for Nazi propaganda, showcasing Germany's 'New Order.' During World War II, he was responsible for war propaganda, attempting to cover up Germany's military failures while inciting the population to continue fighting. In 1944, he was appointed Plenipotentiary for Total War, responsible for mobilizing Germany's economy and human resources for the war effort. As the war situation deteriorated, his propaganda became increasingly extreme and desperate.

points.title: 末日与自杀
points.description: 1945年4月，随着苏联红军逼近柏林，戈培尔带领家人躲入希特勒的元首地堡。在希特勒自杀后，戈培尔被希特勒任命为德国总理，成为纳粹德国最后一任领导人。他试图通过广播呼吁德国军队继续抵抗，但收效甚微。5月1日，在苏联红军攻入柏林后，戈培尔先毒杀了他的六个孩子，然后与妻子玛格达一起自杀。他的自杀标志着纳粹政权的彻底终结，也成为了纳粹意识形态疯狂与绝望的最终象征。
points.descriptionEn: In April 1945, as the Soviet Red Army approached Berlin, Goebbels and his family took refuge in Hitler's Führerbunker. After Hitler's suicide, Goebbels was appointed Chancellor of Germany by Hitler, becoming the last leader of Nazi Germany. He attempted to urge German forces to continue fighting through radio broadcasts, but with little effect. On May 1, after Soviet forces entered Berlin, Goebbels first poisoned his six children before committing suicide with his wife Magda. His suicide marked the definitive end of the Nazi regime and became the final symbol of the madness and desperation of Nazi ideology.

supporter.zh: 在纳粹支持者眼中，戈培尔被视为天才的宣传大师和忠诚的纳粹战士。他们认为他成功地将纳粹意识形态传播给德国民众，为国家重建和民族复兴做出了重要贡献。支持者赞扬他的演讲才能和宣传技巧，认为他能够激发德国人民的爱国热情和民族自豪感。在他们的叙事中，戈培尔是德国抵抗外部敌人、实现民族复兴的关键人物之一。
supporter.en: In the eyes of Nazi supporters, Goebbels was regarded as a genius propaganda master and a loyal Nazi warrior. They believed he successfully spread Nazi ideology to the German people and made significant contributions to national reconstruction and revival. Supporters praised his oratory skills and propaganda techniques, arguing that he could inspire German patriotism and national pride. In their narrative, Goebbels was one of the key figures in Germany's resistance against external enemies and the realization of national rejuvenation.

critic.zh: 批评者认为戈培尔是现代宣传术的先驱和操纵民意的恶魔。他们谴责他利用'大谎言'理论系统性地欺骗德国民众，为纳粹的种族灭绝政策和侵略战争铺平道路。批评者指出，他的宣传手段包括制造虚假信息、煽动仇恨、压制异议和思想控制，这些做法严重破坏了民主社会的根基。历史学家普遍认为，戈培尔是纳粹政权中最具破坏性的人物之一，他的宣传机器对二战的爆发和纳粹暴行的实施负有不可推卸的责任。
critic.en: Critics view Goebbels as a pioneer of modern propaganda and a master of manipulating public opinion. They condemn his use of the 'big lie' theory to systematically deceive the German people, paving the way for Nazi genocide policies and aggressive wars. Critics point out that his propaganda methods included spreading disinformation, inciting hatred, suppressing dissent, and thought control, which severely undermined the foundations of democratic society. Historians generally regard Goebbels as one of the most destructive figures in the Nazi regime, holding his propaganda machine responsible for the outbreak of World War II and the implementation of Nazi atrocities.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，戈培尔已成为宣传和极权主义政治的象征性人物。他的名字与'宣传'一词几乎同义，成为政治操纵和思想控制的代名词。在学术研究中，戈培尔被视为现代政治宣传研究的典型案例，他的方法和技巧被广泛研究。在流行文化中，戈培尔经常被描绘为纳粹政权的'邪恶天才'，他的形象出现在众多电影、书籍和艺术作品中，警示世人宣传的危险性和极权主义的危害。他的生平也成为了研究独裁政权如何利用媒体和宣传工具维持权力的重要案例。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Goebbels has become a symbolic figure of propaganda and totalitarian politics. His name is almost synonymous with 'propaganda,' serving as a byword for political manipulation and thought control. In academic research, Goebbels is regarded as a classic case study in modern political propaganda, with his methods and techniques widely studied. In popular culture, Goebbels is often depicted as the 'evil genius' of the Nazi regime, appearing in numerous films, books, and artworks that warn of the dangers of propaganda and the perils of totalitarianism. His life has also become an important case study for examining how dictatorships use media and propaganda tools to maintain power.

self.zh: 宣传的唯一原则就是：只要谎言足够大，只要它被足够频繁地重复，最终人们就会相信它。
self.en: The principle of propaganda is: the bigger the lie, the more it will be believed.

others.zh: 戈培尔是纳粹政权中最具才华、最危险的人物。他不仅能够理解群众心理，还能够操纵它，使其服务于纳粹的目的。
others.en: Goebbels was the most talented and dangerous man in the Nazi regime. He not only understood the psychology of the masses but could manipulate it to serve Nazi purposes.
